description: Ordered actual-engine economic replay. Not a browser/human playthrough or duration validation.
assumptions: Starts with one level-5 budfox and createGame inventory. Party, XP, currency and stock carry forward.
Eight scheduled wild encounters per island, two from each local family; real capture probabilities and battle outcomes.
Assumes outdoor caches and optional stories are discovered; first story branches chosen. Optional relic instruments added in 0.6 are NOT solved or rewarded by this replay.
Free clinic/camp recovery between outdoor fights; dungeon damage carries through inventory, defeat retreats or final-floor spring.
Known rune/sequence puzzle answers supplied. No walking, random encounter frequency, puzzle discovery or human strategy timing simulated.
180-turn diagnostic caps in earlier work were not proof of a deadlock. Current cap360; failures are reported, never assigned wins.
